steps.en: Review setup and register REA with your agent
steps.zh: 审查安装向导并接入 agent

steps.en: Supply an authorized local app and ask a behavior question
steps.zh: 提供有权检查的本地应用和行为问题

steps.en: Inspect artifacts and return findings with evidence and limitations
steps.zh: 检查产物并返回带证据及局限的结果

steps.en: Explain findings; independently implement only after separately obtaining all necessary rights
steps.zh: 解释结果；另获必要权利后才独立实现

value.en: Explain a source-unavailable feature from inspectable evidence
value.zh: 用可检查的证据解释无源码的功能
